  <title>Medline Updates Customers and Patients on Repair and Replace Program for Recall of Medline Brand Beds, Rails, Mattresses and Accessories</title>
  <link>http://www.fda.gov/safety/recalls-market-withdrawals-safety-alerts/medline-updates-customers-and-patients-repair-and-replace-program-recall-medline-brand-beds-rails</link>
  <description>On October 14, 2026, Medline initiated a product recall, market exit and discontinuation of all Medline Brand beds, rails, mattresses, and accessories (e.g., pendants and motor boxes) due to a potential fire hazard and entrapment risk, which may result in patient injury or death. As of November 8, 2</description>
